summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test via ref.startswith(str(self)), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when ref equals a stored term URI under node-type-aware equality (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Added tests to test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership for Namespace, closed membership for RDFS (defined term, undefined term sharing the base, plain string and Literal negatives) and RDF (defined term). Nothing was run, per the instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. No commits were made. NamespaceManager membership was not added (optional in the spec).
